# Election update: Thursday, November 5 (evening)

## Bottom line
The House results table now marks 407 of 435 races called: D 253, R 154, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Counting ME-02, which news outlets report as decided after the Democrat conceded, it is D 253, R 155. CNN projects Democrats will win more than 250 House seats ([CNN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNMmx1N2JlVTE0Y2M0YldEeEtmT1pZR3BPRFc5TW1QcVF0RnAyZlUxd2lXYUhVWk9EQ1BUSmV3amFncDlVYnUtRmhpekF3RFpVMXUzeEFYaHA1WFppclJQeVJCRWNveHE1V2VLb21Jal9JaHBqZ3FnRnprSmtyZmpoRw?oc=5)). In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still too close to call, the WSJ reports ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOTlVibTZCYkdvRVBmRWY1ZnVtU1d3SHRVdTNQTW9fVzg4WFY3ZnIyN1VVT1ktdy1McENvMkItMmo4SldhcjcyM0VUX3VjZ2twc0hfZUNHaFF1bVowVDZ1a0pudU90NWVpamZQMXZhc1ZQR0NTQXhGTEc0RjFHTGxSOWV1RQ?oc=5)). No seat rated safe is within 5 points.

## Called since the last update
- **Competitive House flips (6):** CO-05 (Jessica Killin, D), unseating Jeff Crank (R), per [The Colorado Sun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQSG1vOFVvWGF5WGlLc1c5b0hzNVIwSnV0amUwNTFXRGJwWDVwMFZqbzUwTjZwUXZobmQ0WXZnU3FGb2pSUWZyelF0SlNqSDY3NEMzY0I5TnlvZkxmUXBOVU5pVDJWWDRTY0RrdGd0cGNJbTdTVEJwcGFDdlFaWGZWTnBGRUMxSThramhxa3JsUFVkQ0c2Sklmbg?oc=5); AZ-01 (Amish Shah, D), per [Axios](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxON0RSaWpZNE1tOWEwSXhiVE5Dd0MtdTFERzZnbEd4Nzd5eVFjUWVZb1BlOHpFSXBZY2NkVVFJeVFqU01iVDNuSXdjREhPVWJxV0hVSDNwQ3RlekZ5NmdHMEdXclJMTHFvb0hua2FWQ2ZPNXNlRVhSQ0s0Q0lwb2hYWWRod1pha05vVlFuNTJnMU4xMk93ZDdaTVlaNkxxTWRxR0tQOGNKY1ZlenZSWkZSUUNFU1FjZw?oc=5); NC-13 (Paul Barringer, D), per [Axios](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxPRlV6NDFvZUZTUlF0TTE3TlpLMFI5VGEwTEVaeUYzMXhNX2RUdlRxbl85S29rWTZWbHM3dzl5TW1SU3ExMU9VOTBFWXRpbGdnTFZUalN6YlQteTcxZVBUSTRMdmY2RUdSVXYtYTVuTkxKUlM4UDR5MWpjdlpYS3BnZWNLeEF3b2UzMFlJRGhIbE1xdw?oc=5); NC-14 (Lakesha Womack, D) and OH-10 (Kristina Knickerbocker, D), marked called in the Wikipedia results table, following AP ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)); TN-09 (Brent Taylor, R), an open seat, marked called in the table ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). The Hill reports Womack faces a felony charge ([The Hill](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Competitive House holds (4, all R):** VA-05 (John McGuire), which AP projects, per [WSET](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQazlsdWdHeDdIY0R4ZW5xM2xQMGZsN0F5Vlg0WjdfeTdmdWJNc0xMeHRRVlpqRFhIMmhjdDdaYXYyUVNzR25pMWhkUmp4LWxvemM0enhXM1RZdXNIWllfS2dPeldYVkxFQmZadzRUdjFnM0RkSEt3RDgtZ3dpc2c3Y1lua08yazJWOFpxbjBnVWRLN3c?oc=5); AR-02 (French Hill), per [THV11](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5); FL-13 (Anna Paulina Luna), per [Bay News 9](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPVzk2YnUyNmtaSHFVUEJiV3VnVlF2c2VRcVZIQWtSMk9aeWNFWEVPeEhkVldDbXpDZ1oycmxYTmFta2pYNEl5czdONWxhMG5YdzJSTDFoRURVWk9zVkN4ZVZJazhlcUZSYW01cFIwVjYwcnVVemZ4bXhJZzE4czJFeDAxeDNCM3BtUVhKRjI4T2c5a1ZKMHh1akFyTU9idDdhLUFxY1hYWDYyNXczWWZn?oc=5); NY-01 (Nick LaLota), marked called in the table ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)).
- **NC-13 and NC-14 are back:** the table removed its call marks Wednesday and has now restored both.
- Plus 6 safe or likely seats called as rated. No Senate race was called today.

## Still uncalled
One line for every competitive race the table hasn't marked called, Senate first. Where news outlets report a race as called, the line names the outlet; those are counted separately.
- **AK Senate** (Tossup): the Washington Post reports President Trump is demanding Sen. Dan Sullivan (R) be declared the winner while Mary Peltola (D) leads ([WaPo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPM2lHMzhTTzJ3U09ONWJad2FlSDVDUXlNWnpLeXE4MUlLMUd0Vm4zSUlaaXY5NHVBVF9MaFVfN1BnZ2F5UnR0NlNaN2hFMDByY3FPbVF5c0NJbVJTeHBWNnlqb1lTN2pjSk1JeTVqc1pLNnFZTFNwbWNxLUNOa1lEdDJUWkc3Sy01U0ZNQmZza3RLdi1sVUZ4eHVLZEdFNW9SY0lCeFFmYw?oc=5)). CNN explains why the count could take a while ([CNN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNaWlYaHBKYjRVZlZvcXJISjJnUlZvWFU4N0lfSFJfY2ljOEpuQm5neWxaVnhWVGpsZF9OeUcwcXVfbW1qQzQxSktzUDZQWkUwNWNVR3RkSzQ0NDJTQkFMaDRXZ3gwTDhoZGRMWFdhbGtfNk9fQzU2ZlgxZmNDZHZXamFVOTRlRXdvTC0yVXZkZ2x2VkZvdHFvS3BpMWs?oc=5)).
- **MS Senate** (Likely R): NBC News describes a nail-biter ([NBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOUnBiYVRKc3Q3S0x1UTBoTGdnc1JVTlZ1MFR4Y3psTDF2VGdfcXhCbllDVzd6cTVaRlN5MzRaZjRJQk9YTmlFZHdhZW9Xd0hMUHhFMmlpc2lWNkN4cWRUR0IwRVJpZFlkeFRSSDlWNzlXZUJsUEc3azBEbWVJa2x3MFZMUk5adUcwS2Vrck5QeGVtRjdYcWx2OXlIX3ZmLXZQ?oc=5)), and the NYT's live updates report the Senate lead has grown ([NYT](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNOGJwajJTMnQ4VlgzdDdtOXY4ZmZDWHE1a1JoWG5ZRk1yNU43d29mdl9HUUw4TnJVVWFjQ3lfaGZlSFQwRWcwNmtFWklNR1RtZnlQc3lKMkVOWTl2d0pDNjM1UEk0ZVBKMzNlY3AtQXBweEF2TnhXckFDRmFQYWdYcElB?oc=5)).
- **ME-02** (Tossup): Matt Dunlap (D) has conceded to Paul LePage (R), WGME reports ([WGME](https://news.google.?oc=5)). WABI reports the race still goes through ranked-choice tabulation ([WABI](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Not yet marked in the table.

- **CO-03** (Lean R): still undecided, per [The Colorado Sun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxNRVZoRW9neEl3Q1NPc0x5MUt2MHhRXzA2bDlrM245MXBGUVlranFJeFhFSGRYS1duYVNFM2V4RTUza1lMT19heXZZQnl1RzVTNFhjN29mVmp3YW1JcUxLWVlEa2JSRlJGMnVDWVMzbnZYZmlMYlBaekM4VkhHVTliSnZ2V0dBVGE5OUsxcjNiVHhrUHRu?oc=5).
